title: allium pallens var. grandiflorum
intro: Allium pallens var. grandiflorum, commonly known as the small-flowered ornamental onion, is a type of flowering plant in the Amaryllidaceae family. It is known to possess several health benefits, including its potential to lower cholesterol levels, prevent cancer, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Allium pallens var. grandiflorum include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sulfur compounds, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
